group.label: General
group.comment: The module only produces data for Zaraz (zaraz.ecommerce(), zaraz.track(), zaraz.set()). Tools (GA4, Ads, Meta…), their IDs and consent are configured in the Cloudflare Zaraz dashboard; enable E-commerce tracking there in Settings and in every tool.

field.label: Enable
field.comment: No: no scripts are printed, no events are queued, no data is loaded.

field.label: Debug Mode
field.comment: Logs every event (method, name, payload) and Zaraz spec warnings to the browser console. Works without Cloudflare: events wait in PerspectiveZaraz.getPending() when Zaraz is not loaded. Does not change what is sent.

field.label: Debug Only for IPs
field.comment: Comma separated. Empty = debug for every visitor. With IPs the flag is delivered per visitor via customer-data (never cached in FPC/Varnish). Behind a proxy make sure Magento sees the client IP (e.g. CF-Connecting-IP).

field.label: Zaraz Script
field.comment: Auto-inject: Cloudflare injects Zaraz (default for proxied domains). Manual: use when Auto-inject script is off in Zaraz Settings or the domain is not proxied; the module prints <script src="…" referrerpolicy="origin"> in <head>.

field.label: Zaraz Script URL
field.comment: Default /cdn-cgi/zaraz/i.js, or the custom endpoint from Zaraz Settings, or https://proxied-subdomain.example.com/cdn-cgi/zaraz/i.js for a domain not proxied by Cloudflare (its host is added to CSP script-src/connect-src).

field.label: Script Tag Attributes
field.comment: Added to the module core script and to the manual Zaraz script, e.g. data-cfasync="false" so Rocket Loader does not delay them. Event handler attributes (on*) and src/type/id/nonce are ignored.

field.label: Product List Viewed Chunk Size
field.comment: Products per Product List Viewed event; a list of 36 products with size 20 sends 2 events. Smaller chunks keep payloads under tool limits but each call is a billable Zaraz Event.

field.label: Custom Checkout Pages
field.comment: One per line: full action name (onestepcheckout_index_index) or request path prefix (onestepcheckout). These pages get Checkout Started and the checkout templates. The native checkout is always covered.

field.label: Custom Success Pages
field.comment: One per line, as above. These pages render Order Completed for the last order of the checkout session. The native success page is always covered.

group.label: Events
group.comment: One row per event. Zaraz event name overrides the name passed to Zaraz (e-commerce tools recognise only the spec names, so override only for custom triggers). From server requires Perspective_ZarazServerSide: for Order Completed it is a fallback sent only when the browser did not deliver the event; Order Refunded / Order Cancelled exist only on the server. An event without a row uses its default: browser events are sent from the browser with the default name, Order Refunded is sent from the server, Order Cancelled is off.

field.label: Product ID
field.comment: Value of product_id: "MH01" (SKU) or "1284" (entity id).

field.label: Send "sku" Property
field.comment: Adds sku. Note: Zaraz GA4 and Meta use sku as item id when it is present, so with Product ID = entity id set this to No to make the entity id reach those tools.

field.label: Configurable Products
field.comment: Cart and order lines of configurables: product_id/sku/name of the parent (e.g. "MH01") or of the selected child (e.g. "MH01-XS-Black"). Category is always taken from the parent. Product Viewed always uses the parent (no child is selected yet).

field.label: Product Viewed: Send All Children
field.comment: For configurable products, Product Viewed also gets products with every salable child (variant, child price). Zaraz GA4 then sends these children as items of view_item.

field.label: Send Variant
field.comment: Adds variant for configurable lines with a selected child.

field.label: Variant Source
field.comment: variant: "Black / XS" (option values), "MH01-XS-Black" (child SKU) or the child product name.

field.label: Send Brand
field.comment: Adds brand (store-level label of the attribute below).

field.label: Brand Attribute
field.comment: Taken from the parent product.

field.label: Currency
field.comment: currency and all amounts: the currency the customer sees / the order was placed in, or the base currency of the website.

field.label: Product Prices
field.comment: price (and value of product events) with or without tax.

field.label: Order Total
field.comment: total of Order Completed (GA4 uses it as the purchase value). Grand total: everything the customer paid, adjusted by the exclusions below. Subtotal: items after discount (+ item tax unless tax is excluded), never shipping. revenue is always subtotal after discount.

field.label: Exclude Tax from Total
field.comment: total without all tax (items and shipping).

field.label: Exclude Shipping from Total
field.comment: total without the shipping amount (shipping tax is controlled separately).

field.label: Exclude Shipping Tax from Total
field.comment: total without tax charged on shipping.

field.label: Shipping Including Tax
field.comment: shipping property with shipping tax added. Does not change total.

field.label: Skip Zero Total Orders
field.comment: Order Completed is not sent when the grand total is 0 (free orders, 100% discounts).

field.label: Skip Orders with Statuses
field.comment: Order Completed is not sent when the order has one of these statuses at the moment of placing (e.g. fraud, payment review).

field.label: Affiliation
field.comment: affiliation of Order Completed. Empty = store name (General → Store Information → Store Name, or the store group name).

field.label: Excluded Categories
field.comment: Removed from category paths (e.g. "Default Category", "Sale", "New"). Empty = none.

field.label: Use Next Available Category
field.comment: When the deepest category of a product is excluded, use its next deepest category. No: such products get no category.

field.label: Depth Limit
field.comment: Maximum number of category levels, 0 = all. E.g. 2 with "Men/Tops/Jackets" gives "Men/Tops" (from the root) or "Tops/Jackets" (from the product category).

field.label: Keep Levels
field.comment: Which levels remain when the depth is limited.

field.label: Format
field.comment: Path: category: "Men/Tops/Jackets". Levels: category: "Men", category2: "Tops", category3: "Jackets" (up to 5). Zaraz GA4 forwards only category per item; category2…5 are for Custom actions and other tools.

field.label: Path Separator
field.comment: Separator of the path format.

group.label: Product Properties

field.label: Stock Status
field.comment: Adds "in_stock" / "out_of_stock" to products. Listing products use the listing stock data (no extra queries).

field.label: Stock Status: Property Name
field.comment: Name of the property in the payload.

field.label: Review Count
field.comment: Adds the number of approved reviews of the store (one query per list).

field.label: Review Count: Property Name
field.comment: Name of the property in the payload.

field.label: Rating
field.comment: Adds the average rating 0–5 with one decimal (e.g. 4.3).

field.label: Rating: Property Name
field.comment: Name of the property in the payload.

field.label: On Sale
field.comment: Adds true when the final price (special price, catalog rule) is lower than the regular price.

field.label: On Sale: Property Name
field.comment: Name of the property in the payload.

field.label: Custom Attributes
field.comment: Any number of rows: property name ↔ product attribute. Select attributes send the store label of the option (labels are read for the used options only). The child value is used for configurable lines when present.

group.label: User and Page Properties (zaraz.set)
group.comment: Keys set with zaraz.set() are attached by Zaraz to later zaraz.track() calls and are available in the dashboard as Track Property.

field.label: Customer ID
field.comment: zaraz.set(key, "123", {scope: "session"}) for logged-in customers, unset on logout. Delivered via customer-data, never cached.

field.label: Customer ID: Key
field.comment: Key passed to zaraz.set().

field.label: Customer Group
field.comment: Group code, e.g. "NOT LOGGED IN", "General", scope session.

field.label: Customer Group: Key
field.comment: Key passed to zaraz.set().

field.label: Page Type
field.comment: home, category, product, search, cart, checkout, purchase, cms, wishlist, compare, other; scope page.

field.label: Page Type: Key
field.comment: Key passed to zaraz.set().

field.label: Page Name
field.comment: Page title; scope page.

field.label: Page Name: Key
field.comment: Key passed to zaraz.set().

field.label: Email Hash (SHA-256)
field.comment: SHA-256 of the trimmed lowercase email of a logged-in customer, scope session. The raw email is never sent.

field.label: Email Hash (SHA-256): Key
field.comment: Key passed to zaraz.set().

field.label: Remember Lists
field.comment: The browser remembers (localStorage) the list a product was clicked in (list_id, list_name, position) and adds it to Product Viewed, Product Added/Removed, Cart Viewed, checkout events and Order Completed of that product.

field.label: Remember For (minutes)
field.comment: How long a clicked list is attributed. 1440 = one day.

group.label: Google Ads Data
group.comment: Discount, coupon and order totals are standard Order Completed properties and are always sent.

field.label: Add Google Ads Data to Order Completed
field.comment: Only data: the Ads conversion (ID, label) is an action in the Zaraz dashboard that uses these properties.

field.label: New Customer
field.comment: new_customer: true when the customer (or guest email) has no other non-canceled orders.

field.label: Customer Lifetime Value
field.comment: customer_lifetime_value: all non-canceled orders minus refunds, base currency.

field.label: Cart Items
field.comment: ads_items: [{id, quantity, price}] with the same id as product_id (for Ads cart data / dynamic remarketing).

field.label: Enhanced Conversions
field.comment: Adds ec_* properties from the billing address. Not confirmed to be supported by the Zaraz Google Ads tool by Cloudflare documentation.

field.label: Enhanced Conversions Fields
field.comment: Email, phone, names and street are SHA-256 of normalized values; city, region, postal code, country are plain (Google requirements).

field.label: Skip Zero Total Orders
field.comment: No Ads data for orders with grand total 0 (Order Completed itself follows the Orders settings).
